description: Search open grants, tenders, fellowships and other funding calls. Returns facts and the official link, from the first 50 rows of a list.

language.description: Language for translated titles. Without it, titles stay in the source language.

offset.description: How many rows to skip, to read the next page. Default 0.

query.description: Words to search for, in any language.

region.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes, or EU, UK or GLOBAL. GB is written UK. A country lists its own calls; add EU for EU-wide programmes.

sort.description: Soonest deadline first (default), or newest first.

type.description: Only this kind of call. Without it, every kind.

worldwide.description: Also include calls that declare worldwide eligibility.

name: search_open_calls
title: Search open calls
